column5: 1. Kalluri et al. (2022) – The Way Forward for Building Energy Benchmarking in India (BuildSys 2022). Gives residential EUI benchmark (~60 kWh/m²/year).

2. GBPN & CEPT University (2014) – Residential Buildings in India: Energy Use Projections and Savings Potentials. Provides Ahmedabad climate data, residential energy modelling, appliance surveys, and EPI analysis.
3. Energy Conservation Building Code (ECBC) – Residential lighting and internal load guidance.
4. EnergyPlus Residential Prototype Buildings – Peak load and internal gains used internationally as archetype values.
5. LBNL / CityBES documentation – Building archetype assumptions and benchmark methodology.
